text.content:
Combination Disciplines are unique compound powers anarchs have developed by fusing two or more standard Disciplines together, discovered independently across the Movement over the centuries. Wise anarchs guard these secrets closely, since they represent one of the few genuine edges the Cause holds over the sects.

Requirements to Learn One

  • A character must already possess every prerequisite Discipline at the stated rating before he can even attempt to learn a combination Discipline. A character who meets the prerequisites but hasn't yet spent the Experience Traits to learn the combination Discipline simply doesn't understand how to perform it.
  • Combination Disciplines cannot be taken at character creation, no matter how well a backstory might justify it. They require an in-character teacher and are best earned only after a period of investigation and hands-on experimentation.
  • Storytellers are encouraged to have players spend the required Experience Traits gradually over time (rather than all at once) so that acquiring the power becomes part of the character's ongoing story, and to make finding a qualified teacher itself the subject of a storyline — such teachers and their unique variant Disciplines are rare.
  • A Storyteller may disallow any or all combination Disciplines in her chronicle at her discretion.

Power Level

For the purposes of resisting or comparing power, a combination Discipline is treated as being the same level as the highest-level prerequisite Discipline it requires. For example, a combination Discipline requiring two Basic Disciplines and one Advanced Discipline is itself considered an Advanced power.
